about: Open port findings of the stored step scenarios, exactly as step_check.py reports them on build/current/portable. A scenario not listed must be ORIGINAL_EQUAL_ALL. The upper-layer test fails on any change: an earlier stop is a regression, a later one means a finding was fixed and this file is updated in the same commit. Findings and their layers are in evidence/port/verification-matrix.json. ant-commands and interactive-play currently depend on native stack residue in mains uninitialised stamp (WaitedEnough); see evidence/port/verification-matrix.json.
